data.body: OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-19): Wire Gerrit CI to run the 5 token-backed zizmor audits (impostor-commit, ref-confusion, known-vulnerable-actions, stale-action-refs, ref-version-mismatch) by providing a GitHub token to the zizmor step in the Gerrit Verify workflow. Keep local 'make lint' portable/offline (no token required); the online audits run in CI only. This preserves project.portability: CI-enabled capability with an offline local fallback. RESOLUTION: add the token env to the zizmor CI step (Makefile:203 invocation accepts an optional token via env), document the online/offline split, and verify the 5 audits execute in the Gerrit Verify run.
